text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Black fitted polo with pale collar and cuff edging, gray olive straight wide trousers, tan suede loafers.. Add ONLY these accessories: Black narrow rectangular sunglasses with dark lenses, both temples visible in three-quarter product view.; One classic silver metal bracelet wristwatch with simple light dial, shown alone.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Edit this exact product photo to remove unwanted additions. Remove the entire scarf and belt. Keep only the black polo with light trim, gray olive trousers, tan loafers, sunglasses and ONE silver watch. Preserve all other cuts, colors, proportions and fabric detail. Empty hollow clothes, no skin or mannequin, white seamless background, full outfit uncropped. Do not add anything.
